item.title: NAACP seeks 'full transparency' after officer shot, killed man
item.description: The NAACP Greater Grand Rapids Branch is calling for "full transparency" after 32-year-old Da'Quain Johnson was shot and killed by a Grand Rapids police officer.

item.title: NASCAR's 1st All-Star race in Northeast has $1 million prize
item.description: DOVER, Del. (AP) — NASCAR scrapped the “ Promoter’s Caution ” for this season’s All-Star race at Dover Motor Speedway and will run a three-segment, 350-lap competition. item.title: Longtime policy pro Erin Schor, wife of Lansing mayor, announces Michigan House candidacy
item.description: Erin Schor, wife of Lansing Mayor Andy Schor, has announced her candidacy for the Michigan House of Representatives' 74th District, with endorsements from several state legislators.

item.title: Sen. Slotkin: Dems need 'their own Project 2029' with clear policy goals
item.description: U.S. Sen. Elissa Slotkin (D-Holly) has called for the Democratic Party to develop a "Project 2029" to show the value proposition of their policies and to go on offense against Trump's "existential threat to our democracy".

item.title: Michigan Princess riverboat in Lansing to be dismantled after 34 years
item.description: LANSING, Mich. (WLNS) — Lansing’s Michigan Princess riverboat is being dismantled after more than three decades on Grand River, bringing an end to a fixture of the capital city’s riverfront that carried more than half a million passengers since its debut in 1991. item.title: Resolution introduced to formally commemorate historic Team USA women's and men's hockey wins
item.description: U.S. Senators Gary Peters and Elissa Slotkin are leading a Senate resolution honoring the U.S. women's and men's ice hockey teams for winning gold at the 2026 Winter Olympics, with a focus on the Michiganders who helped make it happen.

item.title: Lawmakers introduce bipartisan bills to halt data center construction
item.description: LANSING, Mich. (WLNS) - New bills introduced in the Michigan House of Representatives Thursday would place a moratorium on the construction of all data centers until April 1, 2027.
